description: This Java class 'ScriptUtil' provides utility methods for integrating scripting engines (via JSR-223) into the OFBiz framework. It manages script compilation, execution, context creation, and supports multiple scripting languages, including Groovy. It also handles caching of compiled scripts and provides mechanisms for secure variable bindings.

classes.name: ProtectedBindings
classes.description: A custom implementation of Bindings that enforces read-only restrictions on protected keys.

methods.name: compileScriptFile
methods.description: Compiles a script from a file path if supported by the scripting engine, caching the result.

methods.name: compileScriptString
methods.description: Compiles a script from a string for a given language, caching the compiled script.

methods.name: createScriptContext
methods.description: Creates a ScriptContext with the provided context map, including helper objects and bindings.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a script string in a specified language with a given script class and context.

methods.name: executeScript
methods.description: Executes a compiled script or script file at a location, optionally invoking a specific function.

methods.name: parseScript
methods.description: Parses a script into a class if the language supports it (e.g., Groovy).
